title: Siena, Concistoro 2308 fasc. 2 no. 21: an informal letter 'Karissimo come padre', 15th century (unread)

documents.shelfmark: Archivio di Stato di Siena, Concistoro 2308 fasc. 2, no. 21; DECODE R4809 (Concistoro_2308_63)
documents.date: a day of August(?), 15th century (century from George Lasry's report)
documents.route: unknown writer -> a correspondent addressed 'come padre'

transcription.notes: Agent J, 24 Sept 2026; cipher tokens extracted to no21.tok on 18 Oct 2026. George Lasry counts 109 symbols.

system.summary: Substitution in crosses, squares, lambda and letter-like signs, key unknown.
system.notes: Not the no. 8 key; no filed key fits.

conditions.human_role: Set the goal (decipher the letters of Concistoro 2308; try the filed keys first); passed on George Lasry's report of 17 Oct 2026 asking for one entry per key.

solution.what: Found the whole busta Concistoro 2308 on DECODE (keys R4746-R4789, letters R4790-R4814, R1858) and downloaded the images with the project cookie (survey entry siena1421).
Indexed the 43 key records of fasc. 1 (1433 Petrucci, c. 1440 frate Bernardino and R4749, 1454 Milan ambassadors, Casole, 1478 Bichi, c. 1500 and 16th-c. keys).
No. 21 transcribed from the photograph (agent J): 107 cipher tokens, 35 sign types (crosses, squares, lambda), a cipher signature group before clear 'vostro'.
Alphabets of the keys of fasc. 1 compared by eye with the sign set: no match.
Homophonic annealing (homsolve2/homsolve3) on the short pieces: no convergence at 107 tokens.
Split out of the survey entry siena1421 under the one-key rule (George Lasry's report of 17 Oct 2026); its transcription moved to this folder; the report lists no. 21 as unsolved.
Compared no. 21 with the key of no. 8 (siena8, c. 1440-41, rebuilt from its contemporary decipherment): a different sign set.

outcome.method_basis: No filed key fits and 107 tokens over 35 signs is too short for ciphertext-only search; no gloss or decipherment.
outcome.fraction_read_source: transcripts/no21.tok: no token has a value

gaps.item: the cipher in L01, L03-L04 and the signature (107 tokens)
gaps.detail: no filed key fits; no gloss or decipherment

credits.note: Placed no. 21 among the fifteenth-century Sienese ciphers, one key each (report heading D).
credits.source: Email and report to Daniel Bourdeau, 17 Oct 2026

outcome.notes: George Lasry's report (17 Oct 2026): unsolved, 109 symbols.
